note: TinyMind v2 seven-stage curriculum configuration (brief sections 4-6). Read by tinymind.data.curriculum_v2.load_manifest. 'primary' names the capability sources being taught this stage; 'replay' names earlier capabilities to keep, drawn within 'replay_fraction'. effective_mixture() normalises primary to (1 - replay_fraction) and replay to replay_fraction, summing to 1.0. 'target_tokens' is the stage token budget passed to the trainer (brief section 6); 'examples_per_source' only sizes the generated dataset, not training length. Every number here is a policy knob: change it and re-run build-curriculum-v2, no code change. 'corpus' applies only when build-curriculum-v2 is given a prepared real corpus (--corpus, from 'tinymind data prepare-corpus'): 'byte_share' is the share of the stage's training TEXT drawn from that natural corpus (Stage 1: natural text is the PRIMARY data and the synthetic sources a supplement; later stages: a small natural-text replay that keeps language measurable on held-out natural text); 'val_records'/'test_records' cap the natural held-out sets; 'lexicon_words' sizes the known-word lexicon used by the stage objectives.

stage1.purpose: language + grammar: general language behaviour before any specialisation

stage2.purpose: reasoning + mathematics: multi-step reasoning and verified arithmetic

stage3.purpose: knowledge + comprehension: extract and use information from passages

stage4.purpose: instruction + dialogue: reliable conversational assistant behaviour

stage5.purpose: tool use: whether, which, arguments, result use, and when NOT to call

stage6.purpose: safety + robustness: predictable behaviour under ambiguous/adversarial input, and correct handling of benign lookalikes

stage7.purpose: integration + refinement: reconcile all capabilities; no new capability
